note: SC-205 voice-over, one beat a line; gap = silence after it (s). Figures are the 13 Oct production runs' own (runs/2026-10-13-prod-mango and -prod-sad REPORT.md). Numbers written as spoken; 'say' carries Kokoro's inline phonemes for names it misreads.

lines.text: Every day, India's food brands ship millions of packs to their distributors.
But some batches don't sell in time.
Weeks before expiry, quick commerce turns them away. The stock is written off, the GST credit reversed, and good food goes to landfill.
lines.say: Weeks before expiry, quick commerce turns them away. The stock is written off, the G S T credit reversed, and good food goes to landfill.

lines.text: Smart-Clearance turns that write-off into recovery.
It is software as a service for FMCG brands: each gets its own workspace, where AI agents find the best exit for every pack at risk.
lines.say: It is software as a service for F M C G brands: each gets its own workspace, where AI agents find the best exit for every pack at risk.

lines.text: Ten agents on Gemini, built with Google's Agent Development Kit, walk every batch through nine stops.
The Watcher spots the risk. Vision verifies the label. The Valuer and the Router price every exit.
Then one person says yes.
Outreach, the Lister and the Negotiator sell. Paperwork files the GST papers, and Impact posts the ledger.
lines.say: Outreach, the Lister and the Negotiator sell. Paperwork files the G S T papers, and Impact posts the ledger.

lines.text: And from one console, the team watches every client live, and tunes each brand's agents.
Now, Munchly Foods, live on production. First, the demo setup.
Neha resets the journey from the console and picks Rehearsal: one journey day passes in an hour, so the story's real best-before dates still hold.
She can also run any agent by hand. The Watcher flags the Mango Drink at Lakshmi Agencies in Hyderabad: twenty-two days left, and twenty-two thousand rupees at stake.
Lakshmi Agencies photographs the carton. Vision matches its batch, dates and price to the stock export.
The Valuer prices five exits, and the Router recommends a split: kiranas, a staff sale and a food bank.
Priya approves it with one tap. Nothing moves before her yes.
lines.say: [Priya](/pɹˈijə/) approves it with one tap. Nothing moves before her yes.

lines.text: Outreach sends a Hindi offer to fifty-eight kiranas. As each shop orders on its phone, the order lands on Priya's screen, live.
lines.say: Outreach sends a Hindi offer to fifty-eight kiranas. As each shop orders on its phone, the order lands on [Priya's](/pɹˈijəz/) screen, live.

lines.text: Fifty-two shops take thirteen hundred and seventy-two packets, each with its own tax invoice.
The distributor's staff buy a hundred and fifty packs. Vision checks the UPI receipt against the count.
lines.say: The distributor's staff buy a hundred and fifty packs. Vision checks the U P I receipt against the count.

lines.text: Feeding India collects the last fifty-eight, and issues its receipt.
Paperwork drafts every paper: the price-support credit note, the GST memo and an invoice for every shop.
lines.say: Paperwork drafts every paper: the price-support credit note, the G S T memo and an invoice for every shop.

lines.text: Munchly recovers nearly seventeen thousand rupees instead of losing twenty-two thousand. Lakshmi Agencies ends whole, and three hundred and forty kilos stay out of landfill.
But not every batch sells. Munchly's Masala Chips at Rakesh Traders in Nagpur go to thirty-eight kiranas.
lines.say: But not every batch sells. Munchly's Masala Chips at [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) Traders in Nagpur go to thirty-eight kiranas.

lines.text: This time, just two of them order. Thirty-five say, not this time.
On Expire Soon, a wholesaler bids thirteen rupees. The Negotiator counters at fourteen twenty, and seven hundred and seventy-two packs are sold.
In the demo, Neha closes the offer window early from the console. Five hundred and forty packets are left at the godown.
On expiry day, they are destroyed, against evidence. Rakesh sends photos from before and after, and the agency's officer, two witnesses and Rakesh sign the certificate on his tablet.
lines.say: On expiry day, they are destroyed, against evidence. [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) sends photos from before and after, and the agency's officer, two witnesses and [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) sign the certificate on his tablet.

lines.text: Vision checks the label, the count and the slate at the landfill. Then Priya gives a second yes.
lines.say: Vision checks the label, the count and the slate at the landfill. Then [Priya](/pɹˈijə/) gives a second yes.

lines.text: Only then are the destruction certificate and the expiry credit note issued.
Even here, Munchly recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees against a twenty-six thousand rupee write-off, and Rakesh ends whole.
lines.say: Even here, Munchly recovers eleven thousand seven hundred rupees against a twenty-six thousand rupee write-off, and [Rakesh](/ɹˈɑkAʃ/) ends whole.

lines.text: Smart-Clearance. Ten agents, one yes, and nothing good goes to waste.
